overview.about: The Dow Championship is a rare team event on the LPGA, pairing two players who alternate between foursomes and fourball formats at Midland Country Club in Michigan. The team twist makes it one of the most relaxed and popular weeks on the schedule.
overview.nextEvent: The next Dow Championship is played at Midland Country Club, with two-player teams combining across alternate-shot and best-ball rounds. The pairings often bring together close friends and star duos.
